name: advisors-excel-react-challenge
description: Root workspace runner for API and UI services

scripts.test:docker: docker compose run --rm --build api npm test && docker compose run --rm --build ui npm test -- --watchAll=false
scripts.test:docker:api: docker compose run --rm --build api npm test
scripts.test:docker:ui: docker compose run --rm --build ui npm test -- --watchAll=false
scripts.test:docker:coverage: docker compose run --rm --build api npm test -- --coverage && docker compose run --rm --build ui npm test -- --coverage --watchAll=false
scripts.test:local: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix ui -- --watchAll=false
